overview: The Rules, Policy & Equity Subcommittee reviewed and approved updates to three policies governing public participation, meeting agenda formatting, and sexual harassment procedures to forward to the full School Committee.

items.title: Public Participation Policy BEDH Update
items.summary: The subcommittee approved proposed revisions to Policy BEDH regarding public comment procedures, residency requirements, presentation appeal processes, and timekeeping.

items.title: Agenda Creation and Format Policies BEDB and BEDB-E Update
items.summary: The subcommittee approved proposed updates to Policy BEDB and BEDB-E to reorganize regular meeting agenda structures, moving public participation and the superintendent's report earlier in the meeting order.

items.title: Sexual Harassment Policy and Procedures Update
items.summary: The subcommittee approved updated Title IX sexual harassment procedures, including contact roles across school levels and cross-references to related district policies.
